verdict.rationale: Expensify's docs list 'Smart Limits on cards' and describe approving or rejecting expenses and building workspace rules, so some limit and approval controls exist. Nothing in the evidence shows budgets allocated to teams or projects, or limits and approvals being tied to such budgets to enforce them. Missing for 10: budget allocation by team/project, documented link between budgets and card limits/approval enforcement, depth on how Smart Limits work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
